assets.scope: temporal-rift, ardhungol, dreadfell and others' temporal-horror pools (general/npcs/horror_temporal.lua:73, horror/temporal, non-unique, no define_as, rank 2, base BASE_NPC_HORROR_TEMPORAL, default-name image, leaf field dredge=1); single definition; the dredge captain (horror_temporal.lua:98) only lists it in make_escort by name, so escorts are this same leaf

references.note: Approved disc, lighting and camera; do not copy its creature.

Native shape (64x64): a huge hunched brownish-pink brute with very long arms hanging to the ground. Keep the hulking knuckle-walker but a salmon-pink stitched brute with enormous fists planted on the ground.

Five shipped horror tokens (small thin pink dredgling crouched on all fours, dark-brown armoured drem with axe and shield, grey-white shaggy dremling, tan-pink many-armed weirdling beast, horned horror with a bull head and tentacles): none of the three new horrors may be any of these.

prompt_fields.subject: A dredge seen from a steep overhead three-quarter angle: a huge hunched knuckle-walking brute with wrinkled, stitched SALMON-PINK skin in a mid-light value, a massively broad rounded back and shoulders, TWO ENORMOUSLY THICK tree-trunk arms planted on the ground in front of it ending in heavy round fists, a TINY bald head with small pale eyes sunk deep between the shoulders, short stumpy legs, faint pale grey stubble and pale stitched scars across the back, and a few small pale blue clock-cog scars glowing softly on one shoulder. Wide, heavy, round and complete; the fists and knuckles stay well inside the disc.
prompt_fields.contrast: Horrors: the DREDGE is the HUGE HEAVY ROUND one, a hunched salmon-pink brute with enormous fists planted on the ground (silhouette: one wide rounded mass with two fat arm-posts and a tiny head; hue: salmon pink with pale grey stitches and pale blue cog scars; value: mid-light). The shipped dredgling is a small thin pink humanoid crouched on all fours with bulbous eyes, the weirdling beast a tan-pink many-armed octopus-like blob, drem and dremling armoured or shaggy dwarfish figures: this must not be small, thin or crouching on thin limbs, must have no tentacles and no armour. The other new horrors are a pale armoured faceless commander with a raised fist (drem master) and a cream-white floating bloated pear with red sores (bloated horror).
prompt_fields.composition: One compact complete creature on a single circular tabletop disc, steep overhead three-quarter camera; visible clear neutral base ring on every side. Keep all anatomy and equipment well inside the inner four-fifths of disc radius. Base brightness must visually match reference neutral disc, with no illumination spill or ground effects. Disc plate discipline: measured results show generations of this style reference tend to render the disc DARKER than the reference, never lighter. So do not darken the disc at all: render the neutral disc -- including the whole outer-sixth ring band and the area under the creature -- at reference lightness, a hair lighter, never darker (the style reference's own brightness). No warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette anywhere on the disc. Do not darken the creature to compensate either. Add no warm cast, glow, bounce-light, gradient or vignette to the disc anywhere, including directly under or behind dark-bodied creatures. The ENTIRE creature, every limb, tail, wing, drip, staff and effect included, fits inside a circle of about three quarters of the disc radius around the disc centre, leaving a wide bare charcoal ring of base plate on every side, yet the creature is large and bold inside that circle. Draw the creature COMPACT and chunky: limbs, weapons, tools, cloth and effects are pulled in so the whole silhouette forms one rounded mass inside the inner three quarters of the disc; no tip, blade, hat brim, tentacle end or tail reaches the outer sixth ring band or crosses the disc rim. Value discipline (measured lesson from earlier tokens): the creature's large masses are MID-LIGHT to LIGHT in value, clearly LIGHTER than the charcoal disc, with broad pale highlight planes on every upper-left surface, so the silhouette reads as a bright shape on the dark disc at very small size. Nothing near-black except tiny eye slits and thin seams; no black cloth, black leather, black armour or black fur anywhere. Calibration from the previous generation of this exact token: the design and the colours were right, but the brute was drawn far too large: the fists and forearms reached the outer ring band and the plate under and around it came out DARKER than the reference. This time keep the same hunched salmon-pink stitched knuckle-walking brute with two enormously thick arms, heavy round fists and a tiny head, but draw it SMALLER: the whole figure, fists included, fits inside a circle of about two thirds of the disc radius with a wide bare ring of plate all round, the arms shorter and folded in closer to the body, the fists planted just in front of the chest. Render the WHOLE disc, its outer ring band and the plate under and around the figure, at reference lightness, a hair lighter, never darker, evenly all round, with NO cast shadow, no dark contact shadow and no ambient darkening of the disc from the creature.
prompt_fields.palette: Salmon-pink skin in a mid-light value with pale peach highlight planes and warm rose-brown shadows, pale grey stubble and stitches, pale blue cog scars, pale eyes; nothing darker than dark rose-brown except the eye pits and thin seams; the disc stays neutral charcoal at reference lightness with no warm cast. Dry neutral charcoal disc with restrained copper-grey bevel, kept a visibly lighter value than the creature's darkest parts so the two never merge.

assets.gate_reason: Exact source identity re-verified directly against game/modules/tome source (name=dredge, define_as=None, type=horror/subtype=temporal, unique=False, native_tall=False); details and hashes in evidence/monster-batch-v-20260930/source-contracts.json. base BASE_NPC_HORROR_TEMPORAL (horror/temporal, no image=, no shader); NPC.lua:33 default-name image (npc/<type>_<subtype>_<name>.png) is the only image source: no image=, nice_tile, add_mos, moddable_tile, shader, anim or add_displays on the leaf or base; generic actor.image==entry.image single path; native sprite 64x64; leaf field dredge=1 (a flag read by the Dredge Frenzy talent only); talents Stun, Speed Sap, Clinch (activated), Crushing Hold (passive); resolvers.sustains_at_birth() on the leaf but no sustained talent known, so nothing starts; no equip, no auto_classes. Exact catalog entry only, never a whole-subtype mapping.
